headline: Bitcoin hits its lowest since July as ether drops 10%

scenes.vo: Bitcoin just hit its lowest price since July, and ether fell about ten percent in a day. Here's what changed.
Bitcoin touched about sixty two thousand dollars Saturday night, and ether slid to about seventeen hundred. Around two billion dollars in leveraged bets were wiped out, mostly bets on rising prices.
Here's why traders are watching it. One on-chain analyst calls this a deep value zone, though he says that doesn't mean the bottom is in.
The catch. Bitcoin broke below its two hundred day average near seventy three thousand, bitcoin funds lost about three billion dollars in two weeks, and traders expect higher rates.
Here's what happens next. Watch whether bitcoin holds this year's low near fifty seven thousand, and whether fund outflows slow.
